title: Answer from a source
summary: Answer a question only from a given source, with quotes.

inputs.question: When is it open on Saturday?
inputs.source: Opening hours: Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm. Saturday 10am to 2pm. Closed on Sundays and public holidays. Parking is free for the first hour.

inputs.question: Is there Wi-Fi?
inputs.source: Opening hours: Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm. Saturday 10am to 2pm. Closed on Sundays and public holidays. Parking is free for the first hour.

sections.use: Answer a question strictly from a document you provide, with supporting quotes, for example from a policy, manual or contract.
sections.exclusions: Not for general questions: it never uses outside knowledge.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 1,536 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Source up to 40,000 characters; question up to 1,000. Quotes should be verbatim; the evaluation checks this.
sections.missing_data: When the source does not answer the question, found is false, answer is exactly "Not found in the source." and there are no quotes.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

outputs.found: Whether the source contains the answer.
outputs.answer: The answer, or the not-found sentence.
outputs.quotes: Up to five verbatim quotes from the source supporting the answer.
